findings.claim: Frozen router used one 10k-char budget for system+history, so retained system growth could silently evict history. In this session a 12k system plus nine 500-char history turns leaves only system+1 history turn under old logic, while the Drive Aug-4 split budget retains all nine turns. Drive source also records an original 0/9 history-delivery observation with 8,691-12,253-char system prompts.

Drive derives a 22,000-char emergency total cap from per-slot context (16,384/2), output reserve 2,048, measured 3.86 chars/token and template margin. This is a better derivation than a floating constant but remains configuration-bound and must be invalidated when server/tokenizer settings change.

Frozen router reads only message.content; Drive adds fallback to message.reasoning_content after source-reported 6/6 empty-content cases on a newer llama.cpp reasoning schema. In this session a valid reasoning_content-only response evaluates empty under old logic and correctly under new logic.
Drive applies the same context trimming helper to blocking and streaming routes, supporting a parity invariant across transport variants.

crossread_dedup.decision: Peer established only router blob divergence and assigned zero hours; this receipt adds semantic closure and executable logic oracles. Test/eval peer covers training truncation and behavior-eval confounds, not router history-starvation/provider-schema failure.

branch_feedback.harness: Add context-channel starvation, config-bound budget invalidation, provider response-schema normalization and stream/blocking parity tests.
branch_feedback.claycode: Context budgets should be typed resource constraints per semantic channel; truncation must emit explicit loss/abstention receipts rather than silently erasing history.
branch_feedback.frank: Canonical memory availability requires proof that history survives projection into the model window; stored history alone is not functional context.
branch_feedback.needle: Normalize provider/runtime response schema before deciding whether model output is empty/failure.
branch_feedback.clay: Treat tokenizer/context/server configuration as part of the measured execution environment behind any budget constant.

earned_work_reason: This worker contributes high-value concrete harness oracles but does not add hours pending central overlap reconciliation with existing memory/context/test mappings.
